mission_09: Impressive! You have implemented nested cross-validation, the gold standard for unbiased model performance estimation. By separating hyperparameter tuning (inner loop) from performance evaluation (outer loop), nested CV ensures that the test data in the outer loop has no influence on model selection, providing a truly honest estimate of how the model will perform on unseen data. The comparison with non-nested CV quantifies the optimistic bias that occurs when the same data is used for both tuning and evaluation. This bias can be substantial, especially with large parameter grids and small datasets. Nested CV is essential for research publications, model comparison studies, and any scenario where you need a reliable estimate of generalization performance. Understanding and applying nested CV distinguishes rigorous ML practitioners from those who overestimate their model capabilities.
